## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

- Language: Kotlin 2.0.20, JVM target 17 (`app/build.gradle.kts`: `JavaVersion.VERSION_17` source/target compatibility, `jvmTarget=17`).
- UI: Jetpack Compose (BOM 2024.09.02), Material3 + `material-icons-extended`, single `app` module.
- Android targets: `compileSdk 34`, `minSdk 29`, `targetSdk 34`, `applicationId com.mytracksapp` (`app/build.gradle.kts`).
- Dependency versions centralized in `gradle/libs.versions.toml` — single source of truth, do not hardcode versions in `app/build.gradle.kts`.
- Annotation processing via KSP (`com.google.devtools.ksp` 2.0.20-1.0.25) for Room DAO generation — no kapt.
- No linter or formatter is configured in this repo — no enforcement citation available; do not invent one.
- Full conventions: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- State explicitly when a build/test/lint command is requested but not documented in the repo — do not guess a `./gradlew` invocation.
- Prefer editing the version catalog (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`) over inlining dependency versions in `app/build.gradle.kts`.
- Treat `.spec/` as planning-only — never cite it as a source of project facts.

### Never in this repository

- Never commit `local.properties` or hardcode `MAPS_API_KEY` in source — the file is gitignored; the key is read in `app/build.gradle.kts` and surfaced via `resValue` into the manifest's `com.google.android.geo.API_KEY` meta-data, with a placeholder fallback when absent.
- Never assume Room schema changes migrate automatically — `AppDatabase.kt` is at schema version 2 with `fallbackToDestructiveMigration` and no migrations directory; a version bump wipes local session/GPS data.

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prerequisites (from `app/build.gradle.kts` / `settings.gradle.kts`):
- JDK 17 (source/target compatibility `VERSION_17`).
- Android SDK with `compileSdk 34` installed.
- Gradle wrapper is committed — no separately installed Gradle required.

No setup commands are documented verbatim in this repo (no root README; `design_handoff_my_tracks/README.md` documents the UI design-handoff package only, not the app). Known setup requirement:

- `local.properties` (gitignored, not committed) must define `MAPS_API_KEY`, consumed by `app/build.gradle.kts` and injected into the Google Maps SDK meta-data. Setup steps: [docs/setup/google-maps-api-key.md](docs/setup/google-maps-api-key.md).

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| GPS sampling stalls or is delayed while app is backgrounded | Follow the manual background/Doze-mode validation procedure in [docs/testing/manual-doze-mode-validation.md](docs/testing/manual-doze-mode-validation.md) |
| Map renders blank / API key errors | Confirm `MAPS_API_KEY` is set in `local.properties` per [docs/setup/google-maps-api-key.md](docs/setup/google-maps-api-key.md) |
